4 Reasons Why Collapse Will be the Best Thing to Happen for Men

Clickbait-y title, but whatever. I'll bite. Here are my thoughts.

First point, fine. Collapse of a civilization is inevitable, but as always, something will rise to take its place. No disagreement there. Would it be better? That's subject to debate. Second point though, no more big brother? Fat chance. The reason big brother is possible isn't because of who the people in power are. Even CEO's are just cogs in the machine at this point. Rather, it is the nature of the technology that we use in modern life that enables big brother. No matter who is in charge of it, they will have the power to act as big brother and spy on us. (Full disclosure, I don't know much about computer security. It's my understanding that good, widespread encryption could protect us from spying, but it's my own belief that under the current system of governance, such technology will be stunted from growth/development.)

Third point, freedom and self-determination for everyone? Yeah, okay. Most realistically, people will join a tribe that will impose rules on them. Especially with how many BP'ers are out there, who without any structure around them, will head straight for the first system that offers them any. Structure/predictability is a human need. In such a scenario in which we are reduced to warring tribes, the largest tribes will likely be the most successful, and have people willing to die for the cause. Large societies don't develop by giving everyone the freedom to do what they want. They develop by restricting freedoms and making people dependent on those around them.

Finally, the fourth point. Return to primal order. While I agree with the author that the world will be ruled by groups of powerful men with access to resources, I think that arguing this would be anything resembling wonderful is idiotic. The world the author is imagining would be chaotic, with many out on the warpath. Lack of laws means death and destruction for the weak. Would this be a bad thing? I'm not going to argue about that. But would the average man survive an event like this? Unless he joined one of the large tribes that also strip them of his freedom, I doubt it.

If you think the collapse is coming, I don't disagree with you. The collapse is coming, and one should be prepared. But I do believe the author is overselling how great it will be for men, especially since many of them will die in such an event.
